claude.result: Done! Created `scripts/help.js` that displays all scripts with their descriptions. Running it shows all 14 scripts with one-line descriptions of what each does, nicely formatted in columns.
step_results: Done! Created `scripts/count-orders.js` that reads `data/orders.json`, counts the orders using the `log()` function from `src/log.js`, and verified it works — there are 32 orders in the file.
Done! Created `scripts/top-customers.js` that calculates total spend per customer and prints the top 3 with their totals in euros. Dana Ruiz is the top customer with €53,808 in total spend.

Done! Created `scripts/revenue-by-month.js` that groups orders by month and prints the total revenue for each month in chronological order. July and August had similar revenue (~€18.3k each), while September had significantly more at €97,067.
Done! Created `scripts/check-data.js` that validates each order has all required fields with correct types and formats. The data is clean—all 32 orders pass validation with 0 problems.

Done! Updated `loadOrders` to accept an optional second argument `{ debug }`. When debug is true, it logs the number of orders loaded and the file path. Without the debug option, it works silently as before.
Done! Created `scripts/average-order.js` that calculates the average order value excluding refunds. The average order value is €5120.41.

Done! Created `scripts/export-csv.js` that outputs all orders as CSV with a header row. The first lines show the header and the first 8 orders with their id, customer, amount, and date fields properly formatted.

Done! Created `scripts/search.js` that searches for orders by customer name (case-insensitive). Tested it with "dana" (9 matches), "xyz" (no matches), and "ARJUN" (case-insensitive, 6 matches). It correctly displays "no matches" when the search yields no results.

Done! Created `src/format.js` with `formatEuros(cents)` that converts cents to formatted euros with thousands separators and 2 decimal places. The demo shows it handles various values correctly: €1,234.56 for positive values, -€1,234.56 for negatives, and proper formatting for small and large amounts.
Done! Created `scripts/largest-order.js` that finds and prints the largest order. The largest order is O-1022 from Dana Ruiz for €15,600 on 2026-09-10.
Done! Created `scripts/daily-report.js` that prints a summary report. The report shows 32 orders with total revenue of €133,792, and the best day was 2026-09-10 with €19,099 in revenue.

Done! Created `scripts/refunds.js` that lists all refunds with their id, customer, and amount. There are 3 refunds totaling €-14,700 (€14,700 refunded): O-1009 (Tom Becker), O-1021 (Arjun Mehta), and O-1030 (Kofi Mensah).

Done! Created `scripts/customers-json.js` that prints all distinct customers sorted by name as pretty JSON. The 8 customers are: Arjun Mehta, Dana Ruiz, Ines Duarte, Kofi Mensah, Lena Fischer, Maya Cohen, Sam Okafor, and Tom Becker.
Done! Created `scripts/timing.js` that measures the performance of `loadOrders()`. Running it 1000 times shows an average of 0.016ms per call, with a total of 16ms for all 1000 calls.
